title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1989-10-20
lineage: S-VHS Master -> Sony SLV-R5UC -> Panasonic AG-7400 -> S-VHS 1st Gen. Transfer: S-VHS 1st Gen. -> Panasonic AG-7150 -> Canopus ADVC-100 -> iMac Core 2 Duo -> Final Cut Pro 6 -> Compressor 3 -> BHP -> Adobe Audition 3.0 -> R8Brain Pro -> CDWave
source: MAV (Taped by Peanut Production camera crew);Nak 300 Shotguns -> 0 Decks -> Panasonic AG-7400 -> S-VHS Master

ai_review.summary: High‑quality audience recording captures a very good Dead show from Oct 20 1989.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates the concert as "very good, if not great" and notes that the audience (AUD) capture is surprisingly clear—so clear they don’t even need a matrix mix. While no specific songs are highlighted, the overall tone is positive about both the performance and the sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it praises both the show (very good) and the audience recording (very nice), leading to an estimated combined rating around four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience capture described as very nice and clear enough that a matrix mix isn’t needed.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show is characterized as solid and enjoyable, sandwiched between two legendary performances.
